text:
mara: Quick check on a new 'schema diff preview' in run-history. Small inline side-by-side, hover highlights changes. figma link WIP.

olivia: Keep collapsed rows compact and don't hide timestamps.

leo: Normalize whitespace; show semantic edits only.

sam: Copy: Preview change (secondary), Apply change (primary). Preview must not auto-save.

tia: a11y: announce previews via aria-live polite, provide text summary + 'Read full diff' button for SRs. Contrast fail on current badge at 13px; increase contrast.

leo: Dev: server should return a minimal preview snippet (3 lines) so we don't re-run heavy generation. Provide PATCH to stage and POST to apply.

mara: UX: show previews by default when output shape changes; setting to show all diffs. Keyboard: P opens preview, Enter applies, Esc closes and returns focus.

sam: Must show toast with Undo for 10s and record audit. Label 'Pending changes' rather than 'Staged'.

a11y-bot: Generated checklist assigned to tia: keyboard nav, aria-live, semantic fallback, contrast checks, undo toast SR behavior.

mara: Actionables: mara update figma padding + copy; leo+eng spec API; sam update product doc; tia draft a11y checklist. Eng sync tomorrow 11am PT. Thanks!
